answer: The zenith counter is kept in mirror and plume publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2818 identities would post 3988 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
